newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota says considering share listing in New York.
newsitem.headline: Toyota says considering share listing in New York.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Friday that it was considering listing its shares in New York.

But a company spokesman said there were no specific plans yet, responding to a newspaper report on Friday that Toyota president Hiroshi Okuda said in the United States that the Japanese car maker would aim to list its shares in New York as early as 1999.
Toyota, which is accelerating its business in North America, hopes to diversify its source of funds for new projects, Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
